correctness.rationale: All 2^{8n} frequencies are partitioned into eight-type classes by exact column-gauge invariance and column permutation. The sign-weighted coefficient follows from selecting exactly two ones per column; the three-row dynamic program tracks its coefficient exactly. For n=3, 1716 classes exhaust 2^{24} frequencies, with exact integer re-execution, a complete histogram and Parseval identity. Independent row-mask enumeration of 1860 supports and 256 direct character sums corroborate the full exhaustive class certificate; they are not substituted for proof of completeness. Fourier diagonalization gives the 4 gap, 465 condition number, and rank 2^{23}. The O(n^{11}) arithmetic cost follows from O(n^7) classes times O(n^4) recurrence work.

value.rationale: The exact signed spectrum of a canonical labelled 4-by-6 Eulerian orientation support is a motivated natural complete finite invariant, not Nester’s known unsigned count: it yields 29 signed levels, exact rank, sharp positive spectral gap 4 and spectral conditioning 465. The accompanying proved eight-column-type compression is a polynomial-time method for the complete signed Walsh distribution for every 4-by-2n width, giving a reusable structural tool. A future application is exact frequency-selective inversion and comparison of zero sets beyond the first rectangular case; no downstream theorem is required for its intrinsic value.
